summary: The change passes. It sets OLY-B-A1-02's mechanism to the existing `athena strategy` command and names `crates/athena-cli/src/strategy.rs`. The owner stays Athena. The measure ends `status: not shown` and names the new test `strategy_view_is_the_mechanism_of_oly_b_a1_02`. That test reads the real docs/spec.toml, checks the entry and the strategy.rs path, and runs the command over the real map and view, asserting that it reports no errors. I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli strategy` (10 passed, including the new test) and `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` (30 passed). I also ran `athena strategy`, which printed every goal from G1 to G8 with its coverage counts and not-covered rows, and a total of 128 rows. The base spec has mechanism "none", which fails the test's first assertion, so the test fails without the change; I confirmed this by reading the code, not by running it. fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's recorded CI run. All four changed files are on the expected-deliverables list. There are two minor findings: the new test mostly checks spec text, and only the view's counts are checked for staleness, not its bet, risk and open-question prose.
